                by_color.setdefault(color, set()).add((r, c))

    for color, cells in by_color.items():
        for r, c in list(cells):
            for dr, dc in ((1, -1), (1, 1)):
                # Only start at the beginning of a diagonal run to avoid
                # processing the same pair multiple times.
                if (r - dr, c - dc) in cells or (r + dr, c + dc) not in cells:
                    continue
                # Find the far end of this contiguous same-color diagonal run.
                end_r, end_c = r, c
                while (end_r + dr, end_c + dc) in cells:
                    end_r += dr

                    rr -= dr
                    cc -= dc

                # Grow forward from the run's last cell.
                rr, cc = end_r + dr, end_c + dc
                while 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w and grid[rr][cc] == background:

                    rr += dr
